_comment: Three rounds of one class whose sites share Node's underscore-prefixed internals, which are bare-loadable on both runtimes. npm forbids package names starting with `_`, so a bare `_`-specifier is always a core internal and never an in-repo module — seaming a class on one would name a primitive no diff can touch.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the state after the await**

The state is read before the await and `doThing` runs after it, so a concurrent close wins the race and nothing revalidates it in between.
